sources.title: News On AIR, the Election Commission's revised schedule for Tripura, quoting the Additional Chief Electoral Officer

notes: The dates come from the public broadcaster's report of the revised schedule, quoting the Additional Chief Electoral Officer. The Election Commission's own order was not found.
The revision was rescheduled because of the Village Committee elections of 28 September 2026 in the tribal areas. House visits were first due to start on 5 September 2026.
Under the revised schedule the qualifying date is 1 January 2027 and house to house enumeration runs from 6 November to 5 December 2026.
The draft roll is due on 12 December 2026 and the final roll on 15 February 2027. These are scheduled dates and neither roll has been published.
No roll has been frozen for the revision, nobody has been left off a draft and no notices have been sent.
cannot_show: There are no figures yet. The roll before the revision, the names left off and their reasons will be known only when the draft is published.
The Chief Electoral Officer's site could not be reached, so nothing was read from it.
